data.name: भगवान
data.long_meaning: The name भगवान is recorded with the meaning “God, Supreme Being”. भगवान is a Sanskrit name meaning “God, Supreme Being”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: भगवान expresses “God, Supreme Being”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: The one who is independent, powerful, and the leader. They are born to take charge and lead. They are self-confident, ambitious, and courageous.

in_sanskrit.name: भगवान
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has the power to bestow grace and blessings

in_marathi.name: भगवान
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God, Supreme Being
in_marathi.long_meaning: भगवान हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who has all the qualities of God, the supreme ruler, the one who holds the universe in his hands, the ultimate reality.

in_bengali.name: भगवान
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God, Supreme Being
in_bengali.long_meaning: भगवान একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who has all the qualities of God, the supreme ruler, the one who holds the universe in his hands, the ultimate reality.
